HS DISCREPANCY: declared_hs 844590 (machinery for textile yarn preparation/weaving) does not match the observed export HS 840021 (steam/vapour turbines per WCO nomenclature) nor the import HS 84483210 / 84519000 / 85423900. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: company stays in the base, actual code should be corrected to the observed 8448/8451 family (84483210 warping-machine parts, 84519000 dyeing/sizing machine parts) with verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry claim 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is contradicted by the evidence — the goods are textile-industry machinery and spares; recommend reclassifying industry to textile machinery.
